description: Kinema, by Lasya: a browser tool for physically real motion design (spectral path tracing, directable sims) at kinema.codesavory.dev.

color.name: canvas-ground
color.usage: Behind the live render canvas, in both themes. Renders are lit on black, so the viewport never turns white with the page.

color.name: canvas-ink
color.usage: Captions and status set on the canvas ground, such as the sample counter. The same in both themes.

color.name: canvas-ink-muted
color.usage: Secondary captions on the canvas ground, such as the GPU and resolution readout.

size.name: content-wide
size.usage: Max width of the landing hero canvas and the playground. The render is the content, so it gets the wide measure.
